verdict.rationale: Superpowers is built entirely around natural-language interaction with Claude/other agents: skills auto-trigger from conversational requests without special syntax, and slash commands like /brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan provide explicit NL-style invocation for its workflows. Community discussion (HN) confirms real users interacting with it conversationally during brainstorming/planning phases. Missing for 10: independent hands-on demonstration specifically of arbitrary free-form NL commands (beyond the documented skill/slash-command set) and no evidence of a broader NL query interface outside coding workflows.
